title: Russian Egg Dumplings
description: A traditional Russian recipe of egg dumplings made with a simple dough and boiled to perfection.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt.
2. Add the beaten eggs and mix well until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until smooth.
4. Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
5. Cut into small squares or circles.
6. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
7. Carefully add the dumplings to the boiling water.
8. Cook for 5-7 minutes or until they float to the surface.
9. Remove with a slotted spoon and serve.
